name: Data ownership and traceability
recommendation: Identify accountable data ownership and preserve lineage from source to consumption.

name: Certified consumption layer
recommendation: Business consumption must use governed data products instead of uncontrolled operational extracts.

name: Identity, secrets and least privilege
recommendation: Use managed identities, least privilege, managed secrets and auditable access.

name: Machine Learning production readiness
recommendation: Models require reproducible training data, agreed metrics, registry and production monitoring.

name: Grounded Generative AI
recommendation: GenAI responses must use approved models and governed sources with evaluation and traceability.

name: Governed agent actions
recommendation: Agent reasoning may be probabilistic; material actions require explicit tool boundaries, auditability and approval according to risk.

name: Cloud cost accountability
recommendation: Define cost owner, budget, labels and consumption monitoring before production.
